# `crs_report_files`

**Congressional Research Service report files**

File subjects linked to qualified CRS metadata revisions and exact original receipts. Numbered PDF locators state an edition. Mutable HTML remains an unbound observation even when offered beside a numbered PDF. Text is a derivative pinned to its original digest and processor. Missing or corrupt retained bytes refuse reuse. Explicit printed report/version footer mismatches withhold qualified version and usable text.

**Coverage.** Window. Explicitly selected numbered PDFs and complementary offered HTML only. Retained files and metadata observations do not establish complete edition history. *(measured 2026-11-06)*

- **Parquet file:** `crs_report_files.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `report_id` | `VARCHAR` | Native CRS report identity, joined to crs_reports.report_id. |
| `metadata_update_date` | `VARCHAR` | Native metadata revision update instant, joined to crs_reports.update_date; not the file's cover date or capture time. |
| `metadata_source_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | Exact qualified detail original that stated the selected file URL. |
| `rendition` | `VARCHAR` | Selected PDF or complementary HTML. |
| `source_family` | `VARCHAR` | Publisher-stated family path, preserved even when it differs from the report id prefix. |
| `publisher_version` | `VARCHAR` | Edition stated by the numbered PDF locator; NULL for mutable HTML. |
| `version_binding` | `VARCHAR` | Numbered PDF locator or unbound current HTML observation; a cover date alone never establishes edition correspondence. |
| `source_url` | `VARCHAR` | Exact publisher-stated file URL. |
| `resolved_url` | `VARCHAR` | Observed final URL for a network capture; NULL when older retained evidence does not establish it. |
| `source_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | Actual original byte digest, used with CentralRawArchiveStore.open to retrieve the retained original. |
| `body_state` | `VARCHAR` | ok, unavailable, refused, or content_mismatch; an ok PDF without a printed footer still has only the locator's edition evidence. |
| `capture_id` | `VARCHAR` | Original CaptureEvidence observation identity when known; reuse does not create another network capture. |
| `captured_at` | `VARCHAR` | Original network observation time when known; historical custody reconciliation does not invent one. |
| `capture_receipt_key` | `VARCHAR` | Archive-relative immutable receipt retaining the original capture or historical source reconciliation. |
| `capture_receipt_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | Exact digest of the original capture/reference receipt. |
| `association_receipt_key` | `VARCHAR` | Archive-relative receipt associating this metadata revision with the retained file or recording its refusal. |
| `association_receipt_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | Exact association receipt digest; separate metadata observations can reuse one original body. |
| `association_kind` | `VARCHAR` | Captured original or retained-original reuse; association is separate from network acquisition. |
| `error` | `VARCHAR` | Source, extraction, or printed-identity mismatch reason; no failure is treated as valid empty text. |
| `provenance_basis` | `VARCHAR` | Network capture or historical retained-source reconciliation. |
| `original_receipts_json` | `VARCHAR` | Historical original-receipt support, including its exact object and pointer, when supplied by the selected file catalog. |
| `content_identity_state` | `VARCHAR` | Explicit printed CRS footer matches, mismatches, or is unknown; no identity is invented when the footer is absent. |
| `content_report_id` | `VARCHAR` | Report id explicitly read from a printed CRS version footer, when singular. |
| `content_publisher_version` | `VARCHAR` | Edition explicitly read from a printed CRS version footer, when singular. |
| `qualified_publisher_version` | `VARCHAR` | PDF edition supported by an observed exact final URL or a matching explicit printed footer. NULL for historical files with neither proof, HTML, unavailable files, or a printed-identity mismatch. |
| `file_validation_basis` | `VARCHAR` | Observed final URL plus native shape, or historical retained-source association plus native shape. Historical PDFs need an explicit matching footer to qualify an edition when their final URL is unknown. |
| `text_content` | `VARCHAR` | Available embedded PDF text or literal HTML text nodes; no OCR, and no usable text from an identity mismatch. |
| `text_state` | `VARCHAR` | not_requested, ok, empty, encrypted, error, or identity_mismatch; empty requires a successful parse. |
| `text_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | Digest of the UTF-8 text derivative, when available. |
| `text_input_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | Exact original byte digest supplied to the text processor. |
| `text_processor` | `VARCHAR` | Named text derivation rules. |
| `text_processor_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | Pin of the actual local rules, maintained byte readers, and PDF backend release. |
| `provider_version` | `VARCHAR` | Installed SpicyDocs release used when this file observation was processed. |
| `source_bytes` | `BIGINT` | Measured original byte length. |
| `page_count` | `BIGINT` | Parsed PDF page count; NULL for HTML. |
| `capture_receipt_entry` | `BIGINT` | Original file position within the pinned archive receipt. |
